limitations: Single Gazebo run per model/scenario; no statistical superiority claim.
Only single-robot CA closed-loop validated here; multi-robot CA and hardware remain pending.
Clearance sampled at about 20Hz with a circular robot body proxy, not a continuous-time safety proof.
CA is an established model, not itself a novel contribution; no IMM/adaptive switching.
CA covariance, variable reaction buffer and segment guidance differ together from CV; separate ablations remain needed.
CV accelerating scenario failed clearance acceptance; record retained. CA deceleration tracking and angular TV worsened.
Zero-speed fallback is not a proved safe action against a moving obstacle; budget events remain.
Upstream 0.95 inflation multiplier does not establish 95% safety probability.
